authority: spec section 2 + oracle ambiguity adjudications (tests/ref_impls/likelihood_reference.py A1-A7)

adjudicated_rulings.g_pos_covariance: isotropic sigma^2*I truncated to D_img with exact erf rectangle normalization (oracle A2; the minimal faithful reading — anisotropic propagation would be an uninstructed elaboration)
adjudicated_rulings.p_out_form: structural form of p_cens with its own pi_m^o and value head over 1/|D_img| (oracle A3; a b-centred p_out would make L0 bridge-dependent and break the censoring equality's b-independence)
adjudicated_rulings.pi_m_v_floor: the [pi_floor, 1-pi_floor] interval is applied to pi_m^v as well (oracle A4; disclosed extension of the literal clause)
adjudicated_rulings.floors_are_constraints: floor/cap violations RAISE, never clamp (oracle A5)
adjudicated_rulings.off_domain_reports: out-of-domain reports raise fail-closed in the pipeline (a preprocessing defect), while the frozen oracle's A6 reading assigns density 0; parity is defined on the valid domain

g_v.family: beta(a,b) density on [v_min, v_max], monotone-increasing constraint a >= 1
g_v.authorized_data: DiVa-360 calibration sequences ONLY (disjoint from dev/locked/held-out; named at inventory before any statistic is computed)
g_v.criterion: maximum likelihood on calibration visible-report values
g_v.sensitivity: refit on each calibration-sequence half; report parameter spread
g_v.prohibited_data: dev, locked, held-out scenes; any post-seeding model state

h_c.family: uniform or 8-bin histogram density on [v_min, v_max] with h_floor

pi_miss.criterion: empirical miss rates per condition on calibration sequences

g_pos_sigma.criterion: MLE of report-to-bridge residuals on calibration sequences

floors_caps.g_cap: derived: max over the frozen g_v family on its allowed range
floors_caps.pos_cap: derived: g_pos density at zero offset for the smallest allowed sigma with both erf normalizers at 1 => 1/(2*pi*sigma_min^2) = 0.6366 for sigma_min 0.5
floors_caps.p_floor: derived: inf L0 = r_min*(pi_floor) at the miss token or r_min*(1-pi_m^c)*h_floor/|D_img| positionally, whichever is smaller for the frozen constants
floors_caps.status: frozen formulas; numeric values derive from the frozen heads at B2

r_u.diagnostics: forward-backward track consistency + multi-camera reprojection agreement (exact mapping frozen with the tracker artifact manifest)

d_u.definition: pre-gap detectability: the cluster's visible-report rate in its anchor intervals, clipped to [0,1]
